== Summary ==
Original Players Committee Virtual slip: •A Tremor In The Force (V), from the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Page 1, left column, row 1, slip “1”. Old pre-template slip (before the Players Committee remastered the set in December 2006). Cropped unchanged from a 300 dpi render of the PDF page (no retouching).

Source: https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=1

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-a/a3/VS3-2002-1-A_Tremor_In_The_Force.png Internet Archive item].
